stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician says he proved a 165-year-old math problem with Claude
stories.blurb: Levent Alpöge claims he used Claude to solve the Riemann hypothesis, one of seven Millennium Prize problems that's stumped mathematicians since 1859. The proof hasn't been verified yet, and Anthropic hasn't commented. Alpöge says he waited until after the company's IPO to publish.
stories.why_it_matters: If verified, it's the clearest sign yet that AI can crack problems humans couldn't solve alone.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

stories.headline: Google's Genie 4 lets you edit AI worlds just by talking to them
stories.blurb: Google AI Ultra subscribers can now generate interactive 3D environments and modify them in real time with text prompts—change the weather, add characters, or adjust audio on the fly. A built-in agent helps you build complex scenes through conversation, and you can share creations in a community gallery where others can remix them.
stories.why_it_matters: AI world-building just became conversational instead of technical.

stories.headline: OpenAI's o3 redesigned parts of its first chip—and AMD's GPU
stories.blurb: GPT-o3 mini rewrote hardware logic for OpenAI's Jalapeño inference chip, cutting area by 10-13% in key compute blocks and speeding up a multiplier from two clock cycles to one. The same approach found a 14% gain on AMD's flagship GPU. Both shipped to silicon.
stories.why_it_matters: AI models are now writing production hardware that powers other AI models.
stories.original_headline: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models

stories.headline: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on US companies building AI data centers abroad
stories.blurb: At a press conference Friday, Trump said he'll impose major taxes on companies that build data centers outside the US, comparing it to chip manufacturing moving overseas. He floated the idea publicly for the first time, saying 'China will take them all' if the US allows it—though he hadn't yet told his own staff.
stories.why_it_matters: Data center policy is now a presidential priority, even as local governments restrict new builds at home.
stories.original_headline: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

stories.headline: ChatGPT's autonomous Dots agents are coming to the $20/month tier
stories.blurb: OpenAI is testing Dots — AI agents that work on tasks autonomously in the background — with ChatGPT Plus subscribers. The agents can control your PC, interact with 4,000+ apps, and keep working even when you're not checking in. They're also rolling out to all Business Standard users today.
stories.why_it_matters: The cheapest paid ChatGPT tier now gets always-on agents that can handle tasks while you do something else.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI is testing Dots personal agents on its $20 per month Plus tier
